content.title: Where to watch LA Galaxy vs Toluca live in the USA: date, time, and broadcast info for Champions Cup quarterfinal 2nd leg
content.text: Los Angeles Galaxy must overturn a two-goal deficit if they are to maintain their pursuit of a second CONCACAF title, as Toluca visit the MLS team in the second leg of the Champions Cup quarterfinals this evening.Gabriel Pec and Marco Reus both scored for the Galaxy in last week’s first leg, but a Paulinho hat-trick led two-time winners Toluca to a 4-2 victory in Mexico. Nicolás Castro also netted for Los Diablos Rojos. LA Galaxy vs Toluca: kickoff timesKickoff at Dignity Health Sports Park in Carson, California, is scheduled for 9:00 p.m. ET/6:00 p.m. PT.How can I watch LA Galaxy vs Toluca in the U.S.?Viewers in the United States can watch today’s quarterfinal second leg on Fox Sports 1, Fox One, TUDN USA and ViX. You can also stream the Galaxy vs Toluca on fubo, which offers new users a free trial.You’ll also be able to follow live-text commentary of the game with AS USA: Dane Arlauckas will be talking you through all the action at Dignity Health Sports Park.Paulinho netted a hat-trick in last week's quarterfinal first leg.Eloisa SanchezGalaxy’s last five results:Apr. 11: Austin FC 1-2 LA Galaxy, MLSApr. 8: Toluca 4-2 LA Galaxy, CCCApr. 4: LA Galaxy 1-2 Minnesota United, MLSMar. 22: Portland Timbers 1-1 LA Galaxy, MLSMar. 19: Mount Pleasant 0-3 LA Galaxy, CCCToluca’s last five results:Apr. 12: Toluca 1-1 Atlético San Luis, Liga MXApr. 8: Toluca 4-2 LA Galaxy, CCCApr. 4: Querétaro 1-0 Toluca, Liga MXMar. 22: Pachuca 1-1 Toluca, Liga MXMar. 18: Toluca 4-0 San Diego FC, CCCWhat happens if the quarterfinal ends in a tie?If the scores are level after the regulation 90 minutes tonight, the team that has scored more away goals will qualify for the Champions Cup semifinals. If the Galaxy and Toluca cannot be separated by the away-goals rule, the quarterfinal will go to extra time. If the teams are still level after the additional 30 minutes, the series will be settled by a penalty shootout. In extra time, the away-goals rule is no longer in force.Who will the Galaxy or Toluca play in the semifinals?A Los Angeles derby could be in store in the Champions Cup semifinals: the winner of the Galaxy vs Toluca series will take on Los Angeles FC, who completed a 4-1 aggregate win over holders Cruz Azul on Tuesday. In the Champions Cup’s other last-four matchup, Nashville will face the victor of the quarterfinal between Tigres and the Seattle Sounders.CONCACAF Champions Cup: complete bracketChampions Cup QFs: second-leg schedule and resultsTuesday, April 14:Cruz Azul 1-1 Los Angeles FC (agg: 1-4)Club América 0-1 Nashville SC (agg: 0-1)Wednesday, April 15:9:00 p.m. ET: LA Galaxy vs Toluca (first leg: 2-4)11:30 p.m. ET: Seattle Sounders vs Tigres (first leg: 0-2)Related storiesGet closer to the game!
